concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work.
deployment: Offline, in-process library call inside the admitted XDL1 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, artifact, or registry is created, started, probed, or contacted.
errors: XDL1-PLAN-BOUND-EXCEEDED (any ExperimentLimits scope, including the total compiled-parameter scope)
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/xdl-lite/requirements.md XDL1-SR-014 (successor, resolves XDL1-RVW-001 no-plan-on-bound-violation), realized by XDL1-ARCH-01, XDL1-ARCH-08 in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/detailed-design.md section 10.3 and section 12.
responsibilities: Keep the compiler a pure offline function: no component start, no registry or filesystem discovery, no socket/network use, no external mutation.
Return diagnostics and no plan artifact of any kind on rejection, including for any declared library-bound violation (per-payload, total compiled-parameter, or declared-core-parameter scope).
Detect a late mutation of an already-hashed input and reject.
state_ownership: Owns no durable or cached state. Receives immutable NormalizedResource values and returns a fresh plain plan dict plus sorted diagnostics; persists, journals, and mutates nothing.
